title: Phase 64 publishes a bounded cross-file conversion stage matrix
summary: Eight named files are now mapped across eight common evidence questions using sixty-four qualitative cells. The matrix preserves entity and event provenance while separating context, authority, commitment, implementation, validation, acceptance, recurring operation, and comparable outcomes.
evidence_note: Phase 64 classifies only the reviewed Phase 62 event set. A Not Established cell is not proof of nonexistence, Evidence Present is not stage completion, and no cell state is a score or cross-file rank.
prior_state: The named files exposed current stages, histories, and next gates but did not offer one bounded cross-file set of evidence questions.
current_state: Sixty-four cells preserve file, stage, state, event provenance, and basis; all eight comparable-outcome cells remain Not Established under the reviewed evidence boundary.
publication_effect: Publishes one matrix briefing, one dependency map, one sixty-four-cell public export, one pathway integration, and this update without changing an underlying event or evidence stage.
